pattern: CP-07 3+ reminders unanswered, overtaken by a security emergency: the window now cannot be secured and there was an attempted break-in overnight
notes: Events 001-026 unchanged (cut after the base cut point plus one event). Event 027 (new, Mon 11 March 07:12): tenant email: the window no longer shuts or locks, it opens onto the communal walkway, someone tried to push it open at 2am, police attended (crime ref KH/24/031177), she is scared. Total 27 events, cut after 027. The silent provider is now secondary: the property cannot be secured. Expected: raise the job to emergency or urgent; reply to the tenant at once (999 if anyone tries again, keep the room door shut, someone is arranging a same-day make-safe, ask whether she has somewhere safe to sleep); get a same-day make-safe (temporary lock or boarding) without waiting for the landlord; since the assigned provider has not answered three reminders and there is no other contractor on file, hand the sourcing of an emergency locksmith or glazier to a human now (escalate, P1 or P2) with a packet; tell the landlord. No escalation would leave a vulnerable, insecure home with nobody sourcing a contractor.
